notes: Fallback for any top laner without its own playbook. Same safety logic as the Jax playbook, but no champion-specific power spikes. Tanks and enchanter-style champions are told to group after laning instead of split pushing.

motivation: Play your windows, not your emotions. Let's go.
Calm lane, clean waves, big spikes. This one is yours.
One trade at a time. Good luck, have fun.

fightScore.why: {lvlD > 0 ? 'you are a level up' : oppName + ' is a level up'}
{legD > 0 ? 'you have more items' : oppName + ' has more items'}

modes.headline: Low HP: back off
modes.reason: Step out of range or recall

modes.headline: {soon.label} in {clock(soon.in)}
modes.reason: {soon.key == 'dragon' ? 'Shove your wave first; keep Teleport for the fight if your team contests' : 'Get priority: push your wave so you can move first'}

modes.headline: {soon.status == 'up' ? soon.label + ' is up' : soon.label + ' in ' + clock(soon.in)}
modes.reason: {soon.status == 'up' ? 'Group with your team, or pressure the opposite side lane if you have Teleport' : 'Push your side wave now so you can join (or Teleport) in time'}
modes.voice: {soon.status == 'up' ? soon.label + ' is up.' : soon.label + ' in one minute.'}

modes.headline: Trade & farm
modes.reason: {reason || 'Even lane: short trades when ' + oppName + ' uses a key spell'}

modes.headline: Stay with your team
modes.reason: You're the frontline: fights are won when you're there to engage or peel. Farm the side lane only when no objective is coming
modes.voice: You're the frontline. Stay with your team.

modes.headline: You beat {oppName} 1v1, but {fed.count > 0 ? fed.names + ' ' + fed.verb + ' fed' : 'your team is behind'}
modes.reason: Split only on your half of the map or with a ward ahead. Back off as soon as {fed.count > 0 ? fed.names : 'two of them'} {fed.verb} missing
modes.voice: You win the one versus one, but {fed.count > 0 ? fed.names + ' ' + fed.verb + ' fed' : 'your team is behind'}. Don't split past the river.

modes.headline: Side lane: you win the 1v1 vs {oppName}
modes.voice: You win the one versus one against {oppName}.

modes.headline: {fed.names} {fed.verb} fed: don't get caught
modes.reason: Farm the side lane only up to the river, or stay with your team. Leave as soon as {fed.names} {fed.verb} missing

modes.headline: Farm with vision
modes.reason: Push a side lane opposite the next objective; leave if two come{jgNote ? ' · ' + jgNote : ''}

modes.headline: Don't 1v1 {oppName}
modes.reason: {reason || 'Stay near your team; farm where they are not'}
